name: @haus/icons
description: GNOME/macOS 1:1 app & brand icon rendering engine, versioned cache, and C++ worker runtime for Haus

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && c++ -std=c++20 -O3 -pthread native/src/main.cpp native/src/outpaint.cpp native/src/preprocess.cpp native/src/segment.cpp native/src/render.cpp native/src/composite.cpp -Inative/src -o dist/haus-icon-worker
